comparison: Compared with control empf-v8, smpf-v1 passed clockfree_audit_measurement_v1, ring16_acquisition, and both VAE Tier 1 gates on first run, while revealing missing __deepcopy__ isolation on _capture_ring during five_word_joint_smoke checkpointing and insufficient 2D B=64 post-acquisition thermal settling on model_ae_gan_multimodal.
conclusion: Tier 1 halted with 11/16 PASS (including ring16_acquisition, two_pole, ae_gan_hold, unused_token_hold, zero_tanh_smoke, gaussian1d_smoke, model_ae_reconstruction, model_vae_categorical, model_vae_hard, precision_gaussian_fp32, and clockfree_audit_measurement_v1), 1 software deepcopy error on five_word_joint_smoke (non-leaf autograd tensors in SMPFStepRecord._capture_ring), 1 shared-GPU wall timeout on precision_gaussian_nvfp4, and 1 narrow 4/5 suffix miss on model_ae_gan_multimodal (step 1000 component_center_rms_sigma=1.044 vs <=1.0, final step 1200=0.731 PASS).

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Upgrading EMPF's online e-means bank to a clock-free s-means Scale- & Distortion-Aware Moving Prototype Flow (SMPF: 4-round deterministic D^1.5 seeding, tiled addmm assignment, sse_ema x usage^0.35 anisotropic RMS revival, Empirical-Bayes tau=0.20 centroid shrinkage, thermally coupled Born-Infeld prototype Sinkhorn + RMS distortion shell generator transport, affine-detrended whitened conditional fiber transport, and H_0-connected simplicial chord alignment) preserves all 13/13 counted Tier 1 gates, gaussian1d_stability, five_word_joint_hold, and mode_hold while converting anisotropic, skewed, overlapping, image, conditional, and interpolation failures (including vector_anisotropic component_covariance_error <= 0.85 and mass_tv <= 0.15) under one global seed-0 recipe.
next_action: Implement __deepcopy__ on SMPFStepRecord and _SMPFObserverStepRecord, restore newton_schulz_hybrid_v1 GPU polar profile, and widen 2D post-acquisition thermal settling for B=64 corners in smpf-v2.

study.competing_explanation: If EMPF's failures on skewed/anisotropic vector mixtures (vector_unequal_mass, vector_unequal_width, vector_anisotropic, vector_overlap) and multi-mode procedural images (img_bars4, img_blobs4, img_intensity2) arise from generator MLP/conv architecture limits or DualNorm step smoothing rather than e-means's count-only prototype splitting and missing generator prototype transport, then upgrading to s-means (D^1.5 seeding, sse_ema x usage^0.35 anisotropic RMS revival, Empirical-Bayes shrinkage) and coupling (C_eb, w, ell_proto) into SMPFGANLoss will either fail to bring vector_anisotropic mass_tv <= 0.15 and component_covariance_error <= 0.85 or regress Tier 1 acquisition/stability gates.
